decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - That following approval for refurbishment of unit 1 to incorporate 3 television studios with office support services including a mezzanine floor, new plant area and external cladding to building - details submitted pursuant to Condition 7  (Travel plan),  of approved planning permission  ref 01550/1/P10 dated 19/08/2004, be approved subject to the follwing conditions:-

Condition : 2 - The Travel Plan hereby approved shall be updated in terms of the proposed time scale schedule  in relation to section  6.1 of the report and the revised dates shall be submitted within two months of the date of this permission for approval by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - A report shall be submitted one year after implementation, with a monitoring report with details on how the travel plan targets are being met.
description: Following approval for refurbishment of unit 1 to incorporate 3 television studios with office support services including a mezzanine floor, new plant area and external cladding to building - details submitted pursuant to Condition 7  (Travel plan),  of approved planning permission  ref 01550/1/P10 dated 19/08/2004.
